availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on pages 44, 93 and 140 that the Strategic Report and financial statements were approved by the Board on 25 February 2020; the PDF is preserved with its hash in the source index.
observation: Weak global industrial markets and significant automotive and semiconductor slowdowns created pressure, including a 3.0% Thermal Products revenue decline and lower Molten Metal Systems profit and margin. At Group level, however, revenue increased to £1,049.5m, headline operating profit rose to £134.2m and margin expanded to 12.8% from 12.1%; free cash flow increased to £59.2m and net debt excluding leases fell to £156.8m, or 1.0x EBITDA. Prior Chinese, US and Brazilian exits were completed, announced or provided for before cutoff.
already_announced_exclusion: The China ceramic-cores exit, US Electro-ceramics closure, Brazil closure and Molten Metal Systems first-half restructuring costs were completed, announced or incurred before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event; ordinary lean, automation, procurement and continuous-improvement activity is also excluded.
review_note: Sector and divisional pressure is credible but contained; Group revenue, profit, margin, free cash flow and leverage all improved, and every identified closure or restructuring action was already public or completed.

availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on pages 56, 120 and 168 that the Strategic Report and financial statements were approved by the Board on 3 March 2022; the PDF is preserved with its hash in the source index.
observation: COVID interruptions, supply-chain disruption and materials and labour inflation persisted, but demand recovered strongly. Revenue increased 4.4% to £950.5m and 10.3% organically, adjusted operating profit rose to £124.5m and margin expanded to 13.1% from 10.1%; free cash flow was £66.2m, net debt excluding leases fell to £46.7m and leverage fell to 0.3x. The Group-wide restructuring and efficiency programme concluded in 2021 with the last planned site closures completed.
already_announced_exclusion: The Group-wide restructuring programme approved in 2020, its completed site closures and associated provisions were already announced and concluded by cutoff and are excluded from any future target event; ordinary capacity, sustainability and growth investment is also excluded.
review_note: Pandemic, supply-chain and inflation pressure is outweighed by strong demand, organic growth, margin expansion, cash generation and sharply lower leverage; the identified restructuring programme was complete and excluded.

availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on pages 75, 146 and 198 that the Strategic Report and financial statements were approved by the Board on 11 March 2024; the PDF is preserved with its hash in the source index.
observation: The January 2023 cyber incident and slower industrial demand reduced adjusted operating profit to £120.3m from £151.0m and adjusted margin to 10.8% from 13.6%; net debt excluding leases rose to £185.2m and cyber-related exceptional costs were £14.7m. Recovery was strong: second-half margin returned to 12.5%, organic revenue grew 2.5%, free cash flow improved to a £14.6m inflow, leverage remained 1.2x and pricing and efficiency more than offset inflation. A £6.5m footprint and cost-rationalisation programme had commenced in H2 2023 and was explicitly scheduled to continue into 2024.
already_announced_exclusion: The H2 2023 restructuring programme, planned site closures and staff redundancies, the China liquidation, the 2020 programme and its continuing provisions were already announced or commenced before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event; cyber recovery and ordinary investment are also excluded.
review_note: Cyber disruption, margin contraction, slower end markets and higher debt create a material pressure signal, but second-half margin recovery, organic growth, positive free cash flow and moderate leverage provide offsets; the explicit restructuring programme was already public and cannot count as a future event.
